{"params": {"brg_od":{"value":22,"kind":"hardware","source":"measured","note":"608 OD, re-measured flat-jawed: ~22; matches nominal 22.000"},"brg_w":{"value":7,"kind":"hardware","source":"measured"},"brg_inner_race_od":{"value":12,"kind":"hardware","source":"guessed","note":"typical 608 inner ring land ~12 mm"},"bolt_d":{"value":8,"kind":"hardware","source":"measured"},"press_clear":{"value":0.15,"kind":"design","source":"design","note":"added to bore for a firm press fit in PLA; unchanged because no coupon result was reported"},"bolt_clear":{"value":0.3,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"wheel_od":{"value":50,"kind":"world","source":"asked","note":"old wheel ~50 mm"},"old_wheel_w":{"value":16,"kind":"world","source":"asked"},"lip_t":{"value":2,"kind":"design","source":"design","note":"shoulder between bearings; stack 7+2+7 = 16 = old width"},"lip_id":{"value":17,"kind":"design","source":"design","note":"bears on outer races only"},"protrude":{"value":0.5,"kind":"design","source":"design","note":"bearings stand 0.5 proud of each wheel face"},"tread_chamfer":{"value":1,"kind":"design","source":"design","note":"track profile unknown; flat tread with edge chamfers"},"spacer_od":{"value":11,"kind":"design","source":"design","note":"under inner race OD, so it only touches inner races"},"coupon_od":{"value":30,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"track_profile":{"value":null,"kind":"world","source":"unknown","note":"could not be measured; flat tread assumed"},"bracket_gap":{"value":null,"kind":"world","source":"unknown","note":"could not be measured; total stack is 16 mm, +3.2 with washers"}}, "parts": [{"id":"press_fit_coupon","role":"coupon","material":"PLA","print_orientation":"lip face down on bed","use_orientation":"press a bearing into it by hand/vise","code":"def build(p):
    bore = p.brg_od + p.press_clear
    seat = p.brg_w - p.protrude
    r = cq.Workplane('XY').circle(p.coupon_od/2).extrude(p.lip_t + seat)
    r = r.cut(cq.Workplane('XY').circle(p.lip_id/2).extrude(p.lip_t))
    r = r.cut(cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=p.lip_t).circle(bore/2).extrude(seat))
    return r"},{"id":"wheel","role":"final","material":"PLA","print_orientation":"flat, a wheel face on the bed, axis vertical","use_orientation":"axis horizontal on the M8 bolt in the door bracket","code":"def build(p):
    bore = p.brg_od + p.press_clear
    seat = p.brg_w - p.protrude
    w_w = 2*p.brg_w + p.lip_t - 2*p.protrude
    w = cq.Workplane('XY').circle(p.wheel_od/2).extrude(w_w)
    w = w.faces('>Z or <Z').edges().chamfer(p.tread_chamfer)
    w = w.cut(cq.Workplane('XY').circle(bore/2).extrude(seat))
    w = w.cut(cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=seat+p.lip_t).circle(bore/2).extrude(w_w - seat - p.lip_t))
    w = w.cut(cq.Workplane('XY').circle(p.lip_id/2).extrude(w_w))
    return w"},{"id":"inner_spacer","role":"final","material":"PLA","print_orientation":"flat on bed","use_orientation":"on the bolt between the two bearings' inner races","code":"def build(p):
    return cq.Workplane('XY').circle(p.spacer_od/2).circle((p.bolt_d+p.bolt_clear)/2).extrude(p.lip_t)"}], "hardware": [{"id":"bolt","ref":"ISO 4762 M8x35","qty":1},{"id":"nut","ref":"ISO 10511 M8","qty":1},{"id":"washer","ref":"ISO 7089 M8","qty":2}], "joints": [{"id":"axle","fastener":"bolt","nut":"nut","axis_origin":[0,0,-10],"axis_dir":[0,0,1],"seats":[{"part":"wheel","feature":"bearing bores (bolt runs through bearing inner races)","role":"clearance"},{"part":"inner_spacer","feature":"bore","role":"clearance"}]}], "criteria": [{"id":"c1","part":"wheel","feature":"bearing bores","relation":"seats","params":["brg_od","press_clear"],"check":{"method":"coupon","ref":"press_fit_coupon","description":"Bearing presses in with firm hand or vise pressure, can't be pulled out by hand, and still spins freely once seated."}},{"id":"c2","part":"inner_spacer","feature":"faces","relation":"supports","params":["lip_t","spacer_od"],"check":{"method":"measure","description":"Spacer measures 2.0 mm thick (same as the lip), and the wheel still spins freely after the nut is tightened."}},{"id":"c3","part":"wheel","feature":"overall width incl. protruding bearings","relation":"clears","params":["old_wheel_w","bracket_gap"],"check":{"method":"measure","description":"16 mm stack (19.2 with washers) fits the bracket gap."}}], "manual": [{"n":"1","text":"Print press_fit_coupon first (lip down, 3+ walls). Press one 608 bearing in. It should need firm pressure, stay put when you try to pull it out, and still spin smoothly. If it slides in and falls out, change press_clear to 0.05 and reprint. If you can't get it in, or it feels gritty when it spins, change press_clear to 0.25. Please tell me which happened: loose, good or too tight.","parts":["press_fit_coupon"]},{"n":"2","text":"Print the wheel flat with a face on the bed, using 4 walls and 40%+ infill so the tread is strong. Print inner_spacer too.","parts":["wheel","inner_spacer"]},{"n":"3","text":"Press the first 608 bearing into one side of the wheel until it stops on the inner lip. Use a vise or a flat block, and push on the outer race only. Turn the wheel over, drop inner_spacer into the bore so it rests on the first bearing's inner race, then press in the second bearing until it hits the lip. Both bearings should stand about 0.5 mm proud of the wheel faces.","parts":["wheel","inner_spacer"],"tool":"vise or clamp"},{"n":"4","text":"Push the M8 bolt through the bracket, a washer, the wheel, the second washer and the other side of the bracket, then put on the lock nut. If the bracket gap is too tight for the washers, leave them out. Tighten just until things are snug. The wheel should spin freely. You can use your own M8 bolt if it's long enough.","parts":["wheel"],"hardware":["bolt","washer","nut"],"tool":"6 mm hex key, 13 mm spanner"}], "note": "Nothing changed. No fit result came back, so there was nothing to adjust. The coupon is there to settle press_clear. The track profile and bracket gap are still unknown, so the tread is flat."}
